visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) High-intensity gameplay footage of an arena-style mobile game is shown. Multiple avatars engage in combat with bright particle effects, health bars, and gold markers visible on screen. (2) The scene cuts to real-life footage of three young men in white, blue, and yellow jerseys hugging and shouting in joy on a brightly lit stage. (3) The team is shown holding a large golden trophy while gold confetti rains down from above. (4) A young man with dark hair and glasses, wearing a team jersey, sits against a solid blue background, speaking calmly and gesturing slightly while looking directly at the camera. (5) A final graphic poster appears, featuring the same young man looking forward with a neutral expression, accompanied by the text RE-SIGN and various brand logos.

visual_scene_and_style.backgroundDescribe: The video starts with an in-game map background, shifts to a brightly lit tournament stage with LED screens, then moves to a solid blue studio backdrop, and ends with a designed graphic poster background.

audio_base.audio_narrative_log: (1) The audio begins with fast-paced, high-arousal commentary from a male announcer shouting excitedly over high-tempo electronic dance music and sharp digital game sound effects. (2) A transition occurs where the music shifts to a more melodic, major-mode pop track, accompanied by the clear sound of a crowd cheering and applauding in a large venue. (3) A new phase begins as a male voice (Zhenzhe) enters with a calm, friendly, and professional narrative tone, speaking at a moderate pace with high clarity while the music settles into a supportive background layer. (4) The final phase features a digital 'whoosh' and 'ding' sound effect as the music swells slightly before cutting off at the end of the graphic reveal.

narrative_and_purpose.mainPurpose: To officially announce that professional esports player Zhenzhe has re-signed with the Flash Wolves team, using his past tournament success and personal message to build brand loyalty and excitement for future seasons.

endorsement_analysis.endorsementCues: Prominent brand logos for Red Bull and local sponsors are shown on the team jersey and in the final announcement graphic.
